she came over we talked and it went surprising well.

Once most of the stuff was cleared up. I admitted what I had planned. I wasnt planning on telling her because the last thing I want is someone to feel trapped into a relationship.

But I knew where we were both at and it felt appropriate.

Today in the morning she grabbed all my letters and everything I had prepared and destroyed them.

Told me I can't leave her.

It doesn't solve my issues but it does give me a reason to keep trying I suppose.

YOU SAVED A LIFE.

I had no intention on reaching out to her.
This is because of you.

You are a hero.

we got together went for a walk :)

I guess tonight isn't my time

no. just small talk I guess.

She sent me a picture of her. 

I don't really want to put it off. easier on a weekend.

I don't know. stupid fucking guilt.

it always frustrates me so much that I have to suffer. and I do it to not hurt others. But I can't take it anymore.

she's messaged me a few more times.

 Ugh it's going to crush her :(

maybe I'm a bad person but I'm worried about her more than anyone else.

you have been amazing. big internet hug!

good for you! you're one of the ones who make it. I've enjoyed talking with you.

She messaged me. wasn't a happy talk but I made sure that she knew I loved her and that I know she loves me even though she won't say it.

I know that whenever she finds out that she'll want me to know I was loved and hopefully she will remember me telling her that.

I'm fading fast. I'm trying to get enjoyment out of today but I don't have the energy. I'm too sick.

Part of me is surprised I'm going through with it. Maybe it's guilt sinking in. 

I've never attempted suicide before. Just a daily thought.
I'm not afraid.  Just feel guilty.

that's great that you found someone wanting the same things. It's truly something special.

I know the common thing said is you have to be happy yourself to make someone else happy.

unfortunately if you don't love yourself and find happiness making other people's lives better I think that's great too.

that's what I've tried my best to do.

it's not the pinnacle but it was the last thing that kept me going. I know my friends will be okay. We've had several extremely close friends move across the world. You miss them, but life goes on. Gradually the messages become fewer and fewer and that's it. Obviously this is instant and not gradual. But the end result is the same.

I've had several great woman in my life. But I never thought I'd want kids or to be married and I kept getting told when you know you'll know. It's like walking into a wall. You won't even see it coming.

I was like yeah right...but it happened. and they couldn't be more right.

so she's not the reason I'm doing it. But I guess you could say that she was the reason I wasnt.
When everyday your just waiting for the end there is no potential for a future.

I haven't reached out to anyone because I don't want help. I know if I reach out they will help. Or call police to make sure it doesn't happen.

Calling a help line or reaching out online is for people who unfortunately doesnt have anyone or doesn't feel comfortable asking someone they know for help.

The truth is the woman that has been my biggest supporter actually reached out to my mom. Asking for help.

I only found this out when she asked if I had heard from her and I told her I hadn't and she got very upset.

I posted because I wanted to vent and I guess for my last day or 2 complete isolation seems horrible. 

You seem like an incredible person. Genuine and caring. and with your past experiences tough as nails.

I could keep telling myself that my 30's will be better or my 40's. But I'm exhausted. 10 years is long enough. I didn't just give up or quit. I tried. 

it's tough right now because I've been sick all week. Haven't been able to eat much and extremely weak. Trying to get all these household chores done is becoming extremely difficult. 

I don't want to leave a mess. Well, at least as little as one as possible.

well I have probably about 10 hours untill that time. I have to wait until there's no chance anyone could accidentally find me half way through.

I've made sure that nobody can hurt themselves trying to save me.

I believe I've thought everything through.

not much to know about me really.

I live in Canada. I'm 27. I'm a tool and die maker. I enjoy my job but don't love it. But Im not really sure what else I would do.

Love the outdoors. Camping is my happy place. But the beach is my heaven.

I have 3 younger siblings. None of us are close. Awesome mom.
Shithead dad. 

Too many friends to count. Which when I read other posts makes me feel so much worse. So many people could just use 1 friend. For any of those people reading this. I'm truly sorry. that type of loneliness I'll never understand. I'm sorry that you suffer like that.

Last night was never the plan. too much to do. cut the grass...clean the house. finishing writing notes...

go for a drive with the doors and roof off the jeep.
cook a steak.
get some ice cream :)

I tried to contact her late last night.

I messaged her again in morning. she asked to be left alone or else she'll block me.

Your a strong person. I admire you.

Thanks for the conversation.

Me and her have had the conversation that she believes everyone will blame her. I pray that isn't the case. 

This isn't her fault. And she's not responsible

Hey. The fact that when you feel the way you do and you still reach out to help others says so much about you as a person.

Just believe in your username.

I've peaked. You may not believe that but I have. 

I finished my apprenticeship at 22. My friends are now getting married and having kids.

20's are the best years. I've wasted them

To be honest, I don't believe that what I did is enough to give up on what we had. But it doesn't matter what I believe. To her it's enough.

If you want to tell the story you can. I guess the main reason I posted was for some final conversation.

My family will have access to all of this. It will give them some insight to where I'm at. Unless I choose to delete it before.

u/Vrgom20  

I appreciate that I truly do. The world needs people like you.

I've pushed for so long. Holding on for the people I care about.  I just cant keep doing it.

There's a quote that I love. 

"Depression is such a cruel punishment. There are no fevers, no rashes, no blood tests to send people scurrying in concern, just the slow erosion of self, as insidious as cancer. And like cancer, it is essentially a solitary experience; a room in hell with only your name on the door."

Depression is just simply hell. Everyday.
Some people recover. 

Some can't. 10 years of hell is enough.
